parameters.query:
WITH prior AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS failures
  FROM verification_attempts
  WHERE session_id = $3
    AND $3 <> ''
    AND created_at > now() - interval '2 hours'
),
match AS (
  SELECT customer_id, full_name
  FROM customers
  WHERE customer_id = $1
    AND lower(security_answer) = lower(trim($2))
),
allowed AS (
  SELECT (SELECT failures FROM prior) < 3 AS ok
),
logged AS (
  INSERT INTO verification_attempts (session_id, customer_id_given, success)
  SELECT $3, $1, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM match)
  WHERE $3 <> '' AND (SELECT ok FROM allowed) AND length($1) = 5
  RETURNING success
)
SELECT
  (SELECT failures FROM prior) AS prior_failures,
  NOT (SELECT ok FROM allowed) AS locked,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT ok FROM allowed) THEN (SELECT customer_id FROM match) END AS customer_id,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT ok FROM allowed) THEN (SELECT full_name FROM match) END AS full_name;
